question: The Third United Nations Conference on Landlocked Developing Countries (LLDC3) opened on 5 August 2025 in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Turkmenistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third United Nations Conference on Landlocked Developing Countries (LLDC3)** opened on **5 August 2025** in **Turkmenistan**, specifically in the capital city, Ashgabat.
 
• The conference aimed to address the challenges faced by **Landlocked Developing Countries (LLDCs)**, such as limited access to international markets and high trade costs.
 
• This conference brought together world leaders, international organizations, and stakeholders to discuss strategies and policies for ensuring sustainable development in LLDCs.
 
• Turkmenistan, being one of the **landlocked countries**, played a significant role in hosting this important global conference and showcasing its commitment to advancing international cooperation in addressing LLDC issues.
 
• Key discussions revolved around enhancing **transport infrastructure**, promoting regional integration, and achieving the **2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Landlocked Developing Countries (LLDCs):**

 
 
• Landlocked developing countries are nations that have no access to the sea and are surrounded entirely by land or have very limited access to sea routes.
 
• There are **32 LLDCs globally**, including countries like **Afghanistan, Nepal, Kazakhstan, and Turkmenistan**.
 
• These countries face unique challenges, including **high transport costs**, limited trade opportunities, and economic vulnerabilities.
 
 
 
• **Key objectives of the LLDC conference:**
 
 
• To review the progress made in implementing the **Vienna Programme of Action for LLDCs** (2014–2024), which aims to address the challenges faced by LLDCs.
 
• To focus on fostering regional integration and cooperation to enhance connectivity and trade access for LLDCs.
 
• To promote sustainable development and improve access to global markets for these nations.
 
 
 
• **Challenges faced by LLDCs:**
 
 
• High **transport and transit costs** due to geographical constraints.
 
• Dependence on neighboring countries for access to global markets.
 
• Limited access to resources and higher exposure to global economic and financial volatility.
 
 
 
• **Turkmenistan:**
 
 
• Turkmenistan is a **landlocked country in Central Asia**, bordered by Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Afghanistan, Iran, and the Caspian Sea.
 
• The country has been actively involved in regional economic and transport initiatives, which made it a suitable choice for hosting the LLDC3 conference.
